messages.text: Mija, mandame la foto donde esta sonriendo con la cobijita azul.
Lucia just sent it to the tias chat. She picked that one because his face is clear but nothing else shows.
Gracias. I will show it from my phone after church, no need to put it anywhere else.
He reached for the screen when your voice note played, then Lucia took the phone back before he drooled on it.
Mija, did he sleep after everyone left?
Only after I took him to our room, closed the blinds halfway, and wrapped him tight.
Pobrecito. Too many hands and all that kitchen noise was a lot for him.
He kept watching faces, then crying when the boys ran by. He finally rested when I sang the old one you showed me.
Mija, did Mateo get home before the north wind got too cold?
Yes, he held Omar by the back door a few minutes. Omar got still when the calves started up.
Ay, pobrecito bonito. After that, keep the room quiet and let Mateo hum low like he does.
He is doing that now. I can hear the old guitar one from the kitchen, very soft.
Mateo left early, so it's just me and Omar for the morning. He finished the 5 oz bottle and went back down.
Le puse el mameluco verde de los primos, el de broches faciles. No le molesto nada.
Was the blue blanket in the crib or still by the couch?
Good. Leave the Texas Rangers one clean for Sunday?
Crib. I moved the laundry basket out too, so his little corner is clear before your dad gets back.
Si, y en la bolsa puse el librito de animales con leche/milk para leerle despues de WIC.
I can hum the corrido soft tonight, then the little farm book in English.
Voy a WIC a las 10:30. Si Mateo asks, no drive-thru today, I put beans in the slow cooker.
Mami, in Omar's clinic packet they left that little line blank again. Should I put what we always put from our side of the family?
Mira, he stayed on the blanket after breakfast and kept his eyes on the rattle for so long.
Okay. I found two sleepers in the blue bag from your prima, still good for Omar.
Si, mija. Same as you did for yours. The color boxes never say it right, so write our people line where they let you.
Did he fuss or just watch it?
Perfecto. Leave the Target list in the drawer for now, only wipes if the card covers enough.
Mostly watching, then both little hands went straight for the red one. I moved the soft ball near his feet after.
Okay. They also asked for language at home, so I put Spanish and English.
Bien. Keep a copy in his folder with the baptism candle paper and the clinic card.
Save that video. Mateo will say he is practicing for the tiny cleats already.
Mami, Omar licked a little aguacate from my finger today. Poquito nomas, all soft.
Voy a mandarles las fotos de Omar con la cobijita azul. Ceci dijo que las vio borrosas ayer.
Mami puso la cobijita azul en la sala. Omar estuvo apretandola con las dos manos.
Ay mi nino. Asi esta bien, despacito. Did he make the funny face?
Send the one where he is grabbing Mateo's finger too.
Good. I left the red blocks by the mat too.
Si, but then opened his mouth again. I saved the rest for Mateo with the tortillas.
Sí. Also she asked if we can do video after their comida, like 7 here. Omar should be up from nap by then.
Si, he stayed on the mat a few minutes, then turned his head when I called him. When the blender started, I moved him to the bedroom.
I'll keep the kitchen quiet when I get home.
That works. Keep it short if he starts rubbing his eyes.
Mi amor finally stopped kicking the blanket when I put on the voice note from my mom.
The same one from Sunday?
Si, the low one she does before La Llorona. His hands opened up after the second verse.
Save that note for tonight then.
Tu camisa de trabajo ya esta afuera, no la metas con la ropa del bebe. Omar estaba mirando tus botas como si fueran juguetes.
Ok. Traigo polvo de los corrales y no quiero eso cerca de el.
Cuando sea grande, capaz va a querer arreglar bebederos con sensores como los que me contaste.
Primero que aprenda a sentarse solo. Pero si, le gusta escuchar cuando le cuento del molino y las compuertas.
Tu papa puso el canal otra vez. Omar esta mirando la luz de la pantalla desde la cobija.
Bajale tantito si empieza a tallarse los ojos.
Si, y le puse las canciones suaves de mi mama mientras caliento la leche.
Mateo dice que en el descanso todos hablaron del formulario nuevo del clinic y de si van a cortar ayuda para las citas de los ninos.
Si. Yo solo dije que mientras haya trabajo y el baby pueda ver al doctor, eso es lo que importa.
Tambien mi prima mando ese video de la patrulla parando al muchacho. Mejor lo platicamos aqui en casa, no en el grupo grande.
Esta bien. Que no se haga pleito. Primero Omar, la renta, el doctor, y que traten bien a la gente que trabaja.
Voy tarde. The pens were bad after the gusts, dust all over my shirt.
I kept Omar inside. Trucks keep flying past the mailbox too.
Okay. I'll rinse off before I carry him. Close the front window till the smell passes.
Mija, the lady by Main still has that infant spot? I can ask Tere if she knows her.
She said $175 each week and no cameras. I have Omar on my lap and the bottles still to wash, so I just said I would think.
No te apures. Send me the picture of the paper, maybe your old diner boss can wait until you know who is good with him.
I found the folder with my diploma copy and the apron name tag, but Omar woke up before I could call anyone.
Lucia, te mande el videito que puso mi prima del vapor. No se si sirve, pero por si acaso.
Gracias Rosa. Lo guarde, pero voy a esperar que me llame la enfermera de la clinica antes de hacer algo con Omar.
Si, mejor. Si quieres te traigo caldo cuando pase por la tienda.
Gracias. Ahorita estoy apuntando las preguntas para que Mateo tambien oiga la llamada.
Voy saliendo del rancho. Dejé la carpeta gris en la troca por si mañana manejamos al clinic.
Gracias. También puse el sobre del condado arriba del refri, lejos de Omar porque ya anda agarrando papel.
Bien. Si vamos, sin prisa, luces bien, papeles a mano. El niño que vaya dormido en su asiento.
Sí. Le toca biberón antes de salir para que no llore tanto en la carretera.
My dad asked what we thought about that school board thing on the radio. I told him we can talk after Omar's bath.
Okay. Keep it just with your dad and Elena tonight, please. Omar got fussy after too many people last time.
Si. No Facebook, no loud porch talk. Just kitchen table after he sleeps.
Gracias. I'll save the mailer so we can read it together.
Mateo, voy al office after Omar wakes. Maribel said she can check the cans and the paper for this month.
Take the folder with the rent bill too. Last time they asked for it twice.
Si. Rosa said her cousin from school works the desk today, so maybe it is faster.
Call me before you walk in if the parking lot feels weird. I can stay on the phone.
Ya llego en 20. Did Omar finish the 5 oz bottle?
Si, and he played on the blanket after. Just got fussy when the blender started, then settled with the song.
I'll wash up outside first, boots by the door. Want me to do bath before dinner?
Yes please. His little chest sounded clear after the clinic too, so just normal bath and pajamas.
Mija, I can stop by after work. Do you need diapers or anything for your card appointment?
Diapers would help. I already wrote down the times he ate from me since Tuesday, like they asked.
Good. And don't buy extra jars yet if they told you to wait for the green one mashed fresh.
Yes, just a tiny taste after he is settled, not replacing his usual.
Mija, hice arroz y caldo. Puedo llevarte un poco antes de la siesta del nino.
Si, gracias. We are trying to keep the grocery trip small until Mateo's next Friday.
Tambien tengo medio paquete de panales size 3. No compres hoy si te aguanta.
That helps. I already put 72 gas in the truck and the phone autopay is coming out Monday.
Mija, ya puse arroz y frijoles en un traste. Paso en 20 y no toco la puerta fuerte.
Gracias. He finally closed his eyes after the bath. I have the white-noise phone low and the old song ready if he starts again.
Déjalo oscurito. Yo doblo la ropa y tú comes. También encontré dos libritos, uno en español y uno con animales in English.
Perfect. Put them by the rocker. Mateo wants us to read one page even on the messy nights.
Voy a salir con Omar despues de su siesta. Solo la tienda y casa de mis papas si no llora.
Ok. I put the small cooler by the door for his bottle.
Gracias. No quiero manejar mas de eso hoy, falta gasolina y el car seat lo calienta rapido.
Text when you get to your parents' place. I can grab diapers after work if United is too much.
Mija, I am going by Walmart after lunch. Does Omar need anything small?
Maybe wipes if they have the big box cheap. We counted this morning and diapers have to come first.
I can bring wipes and some beans. Save your card for the light bill.
Gracias. I already moved the gas fill-up to Monday so that helps.
Mija, if you need a ride for the clinic day, tell me. I can move my lunch.
Gracias tia. They gave me the paper with the next little boxes marked, so I want to keep that morning open.
Good. Bring the folder too, sometimes the nurse writes the dates clearer than the front desk.
Yes, and WIC asked me to show them the card when we go on the 18th.
Mijo finally took the small bottle. I put the blue folder by the car seat for tomorrow.
Need anything written in it before we leave?
Solo the little table again: 0 weeks, 0 hours, 0 places, $0. Then I sign where it asks for the grown-up.
Ok, I'll keep it with the diapers so we don't forget.
Mami said she can come after church and start the beans if Omar keeps napping.
Mami put the yellow blanket on the floor and he grabbed the ring toy twice.
Good. I moved the bouncer and blanket by the washer so she can fold while he rests.
Good. Did he finish the bottle before that?
Rosa also texted. She can bring tortillas at noon, but only if the porch is open.
Sí, then clean diaper. I am keeping him awake a little before the crib.
Porch is clear. Just the stroller by the door and Omar's blue bag.
I left the office receipt by the Hereford clinic papers so it doesn't get lost.
Voy saliendo al feedlot. Did you put the little bracelet paper in the diaper bag?
Yes, blue folder. It has the Hereford hospital stamp and that 11/18/25 line they keep asking for.
Ok. After work I can stop for wipes. This little man changed every errand we make.
Mija, pongo la sopa en un frasco? I can leave it after la misa.
Yes please. Omar finally slept after the wind rattled the back door.
Then I will come slow. I saw two loose dogs by the ditch near your turn.
Gracias. I'll wait to walk him until Mateo gets home.
Mija, he looked at Diego for a long time today. Then he gave that little smile when Diego rolled the ball slow.
Was the room calm?
Si, until the pan fell. I sang bajito and gave him the bumpy orange ring, then he held it again.
Gracias. We'll keep visits softer like that.
Mija, Mateo dejo el cuaderno viejo de clases aqui? El de matematicas, con su diploma doblado adentro.
Creo que esta en la caja azul. Lo quiere para medir otra vez las mezclas del turno?
Si. Dice que el muchachito algun dia va a entender esas cuentas mejor que todos, con pantallas y no solo lapiz.
Omar se quedo quieto cuando Mateo practico los numeros en voz baja. Como si estuviera escuchando la leccion.
Ama, he kept turning toward your voice when I played yesterday's WhatsApp.
Ay mi nino. I can send another one, the verses my mama used at night.
Please. He is rubbing his face and getting stiff when the TV is on.
I will record it soft, no radio behind me.
I can leave the yard at 8:50 on Thursday. Do they still want us there early?
Si, the nurse said early, then wait a little after before taking him out in the wind.
Ok. Send me the page you were reading so I know what to watch for after.
I saved the one from the big hospital site. It matches what Dr. Salazar told me.
I'm stopping after work. Need corn tortillas or the little ones?
Little ones, por favor. Elena said they tear easier for Omar to just touch while we eat.
Ok. Anything for the chicken enchiladas?
Just crema. I already pulled out a tiny plain piece for him before the sauce.
Mija, I have a little box from Sofia's baby: socks, bibs, two blankets. Want me to bring it Sunday with rice?
Yes please. We were going to buy bibs but Omar can use those.
Good. Eat here Sunday too, no need to stop anywhere after church.
Gracias. That helps because the clinic charge and gas took what we had tucked away.
Comadre, en el grupo dijeron que con tantito te de anis se les calma la pancita.
Ay gracias, pero todavia no le doy nada nuevo. La muchacha de WIC dijo que llame manana si sigue igual.
Esta bien. Te puedo llevar panales y me ensenas lo que te dieron en la cita.
Si, trae los panales. El papel esta en la mesa, Mateo no alcanzo a leer la parte en ingles.
Lucia, your comadre asked me if she can see the new little video. Should I tell her to ask you?
Yes please. Lucia keeps those in the family group and sends them herself.
Esta bien. He looked so cute moving his feet, but I will not pass it around.
Gracias. He only watched two seconds when Mateo held the phone up, then went back to the rattle.
Mija, I have caldo left from lunch. Want me to leave some by your door before choir practice?
Yes please, Omar just fell asleep. I have to sort his papers for tomorrow and don't want to wake him.
No knock then. Also my brother saw Mateo at the yard and said the nurse with the curly hair is back tomorrow.
That helps. She remembered his bottles last time and didn't make me repeat everything.
Lucia, I made caldo. Want me to leave a bowl by your door? I can hold Omar five minutes while you shower.
Gracias, Rosa. He just finished 4 oz and is almost asleep. I still need to fold the little clothes before Mateo gets back.
Claro. Did that place call you back about mornings?
Yes, but they want money up front and I only met the woman once. I keep thinking of the nursing-home nights when I knew every abuelita by name.
Mija, I made beans and rice. I can leave a small container by your door before the baby bath.
Gracias, Rosa. Mateo is getting home soon and then we do bath, bottle, lights low.
Perfecto. I won't knock. I know that tiny room gets quiet once you two start his night.
Mija, did he nap after I left? He was watching the curtains so serious.
He slept 52 minutes. Woke smiling, took the bottle, and wanted the red ring toy.
Que bueno. I can come fold laundry later and keep the kitchen quiet.
Gracias. I moved the scented candle box to the garage so the room stays plain for him.
I can grab diapers after shift if gas holds. How many left?
Six. I moved the electric bill to Friday and kept the $10 Omar jar closed.
Leave it closed. Tonight I will walk him outside before dark, then Cash low in the kitchen. No visitors if he is rubbing his eyes.
Okay. I put the little picture cards on the fridge too, Spanish side facing out today.
I can meet you by the feedlot gate at 5:20, then we go straight to church dinner?
Yes, but only if Omar finishes the bottle before we leave.
Deposit hit, 1684. I can stop after work if Omar needs wipes.
Please. Rent cleared yesterday and the light bill posted 148.
I'll bring cash for gas. Don't take the long road with him if he's fussy.
Tire place said the repair is 400 if the rim is bent. I told them wait.
Don't say yes yet. I can check the little envelope and see what can sit until next week.
Ok. I'll put 55 gas too, I have the early pen tomorrow.
Gracias. I wrote down groceries 156 and baby stuff 83 from Walmart.
Use the card only if they won't patch it. I can ask my brother for a ride tomorrow.
Got it. Diaper bag is packed, and I kept the blanket out of the trunk.
Okay. I still need the clinic ride Monday and Omar's formula tonight.
Ceci asked if Omar fits the green outfit yet. She wants a picture before Sunday.
Almost. Lucia said the pants are still big but we can take one on the blanket.
Send it in WhatsApp. And she said again, when y'all visit, bring the little hat because the evenings over there get cool.
We have it in the diaper bag. No visit date yet though.
Prima, I found tiny papel picado at the store. Too early to save it for the table with photos?
Save it. Mom wants Omar's first picture there this fall, with the little candle and orange flowers.
I'll put it with the pan molds. Also, did the WIC lady fix his form or still asking you to pick from those weird boxes?
Still weird. I wrote our family line in the blank spot and she said that was fine.
Voy a pasar con pan dulce. Sigue despierto el baby?
Si, en la sala con Mateo. El juego va en la cuarta y Omar nomas patea la cobija.
Entonces llego bajito. Si ponen musica, que sea de las viejitas para que no se acelere.
Asi esta, volumen bajo y la luz del pasillo prendida.
How did he do after everyone was loud at dinner?
Better once Mateo walked him outside for just a little. The dogs barked far off and he stopped fussing.
Good. Keep abuela's soft canción and Mateo's low record, no TV tonight.
Sí, lights down already. He keeps turning toward our voices.
Lucia, voy a United. Need me to grab bananas or the ripe green fruit you mentioned?
The ripe green one, please, only one. The lady said mash it smooth and just touch the spoon to his mouth.
Claro. I won't bring spicy food today then, so your house can stay calm.
Thank you. He already ate from me twice since noon, so we may wait until tomorrow morning.
Mija, despues de misa van a juntar firmas para que no quiten el bus de la escuela y para que la clinica siga con horas tarde.
Gracias, Ama. Si Omar duerme, paso rapido. No quiero quedarme cuando empiezan a gritar por los carteles.
Si, nomas firma y ven para la comida. Tu papa dice que uno puede apoyar lo bueno sin ponerse enfrente.
Exacto. Que ayuden a las familias, y tambien que respeten como nos criaron.
Mija, dejé frijoles y pañales en la mesa. El sobre grande mejor guárdalo; Omar lo estaba chupando.
Ay gracias. Lo moví al cajón con las actas y las copias.
Así está bien. Y si Mateo maneja después, que vaya tranquilo y conteste con respeto si lo paran.
Sí, nomás vamos por leche y gas. Omar ya se quedó dormido con tu canción.
Mija, lave tres trajecitos que dejo tu prima. El azul ya esta suavecito.
Gracias, Ma. Voy a usar el azul para la comida, menos botones.
Traeme tambien el libro chiquito. Yo le canto Los Pollitos y luego tu le haces las paginas en ingles.
Si. Mateo dijo que al rato le ensena la gorrita de Texas otra vez.
He looked at the calves a good while when I carried him by the fence. No crying.
Good. Was he tired after?
Not right away. He kept opening his hand toward my cap string, then the little ball on the porch.
Your dad is going to bring up the show barn and weekend fields again.
Prima, do you want me to bring the flyer from the market? People were talking by the tortillas.
Yes, bring it with the diapers if you can. Mateo wants to see the dates before we answer my uncle.
Okay. I won't put it in the big family chat. Too many comments.
Thank you. We can read it when Omar naps.
Do you still need me to bring wipes and the 6-9 month pajamas today?
Yes please. Lucia said the folder also needs the same little numbers copied for Tuesday.
Send me a picture of that page. If it is the one with weeks and hours, I remember all the boxes stayed at 0.
That's the one. The dollar line stays 0 too.
Do you still want size 3 diapers when I come by after H-E-B?
Yes please. He used the last clean one after his 3 o'clock bottle.
Same little place off 25 Mile Ave, right? I only have the address from when he was tiny.
Same one. Knock softly if the bedroom fan is on.
Mija, I made extra arroz. Want me to leave a container by your screen door?
Yes please. Elena is here singing to Omar and I have my hands in laundry.
Okay. I can hold him ten minutes too if you need to switch the load.
Gracias. The floor is cleared, just his blanket and rattle near the couch.
I can drop arroz in 10. Want me to knock or just leave it by the door?
Leave it please. He missed the afternoon sleep and the porch light had him blinking hard.
Claro. I won't ring. Tell Mateo to text if you need diapers from Allsup's.
Gracias. He ate and settled when Mateo walked slow with him, no TV on.
Voy a pasar con caldo y doblar unas toallas mientras Omar duerme.
Sí, gracias. Mateo's work clothes are in the basket, mine are by the crib, and Omar's little sleepers are in the dryer.
Está bien. Me voy antes de la rutina de noche para que no se despierte cuando llegue su papá.
Mija, I found the little blanket from the Hereford room. Want me to wash it gentle?
Yes please. Keep the card with the tiny footprints in the envelope, it has 11/18/25 written on the corner.
Claro. I still remember that long night and how quiet the house got after you brought him home.
Everything since then has been bottles, laundry, appointments, and trying to sleep when he sleeps.
Leaving yard early. Did you get sleep after Omar's 3 am bottle?
A little. I will try to call Maria from the diner after his nap, but she asked if I can do 7 to 2.
That is hard unless someone we know can keep him. How much did the Main place say again?
Voy saliendo al corral. Dejaste la hoja de la clinica en la troca?
$175 a week, plus wipes. I don't want to hand him over before I know how they are with babies.
Si, en la bolsa azul. Subraye lo de las onzas, pero pregunta otra vez si no entiendes.
Ok. Tambien me salio otro clip diciendo otra cosa. Mejor se lo enseno a la nurse antes de cambiar la botella.
Eso. Dile que nos lo explique despacio para contarselo a mi mama cuando venga.
I put him on the blanket after bath. He pushed up a little and reached for the wood cube.
Nice. Did he turn when you hummed?
Yeah, looked right at me. Rosa's nephews were outside yelling by the fence so I closed the window.
Good call. Leave the soft green square near the rocker too.
He was crying in the truck until your clip came on.
The one from Elena or La Llorona?
La Llorona. Not loud. He just stared at the window and quit fighting the straps.
Keep it downloaded. Signal drops by the feed road.
Can I put the high-chair picture where cousins can see it? The one with arroz on his shirt.
Lucia says send it in the cousins chat instead. Mateo wants the messy one kept there.
Ok, I sent it only there. Also your mom's short clip came through sideways.
She filmed with one hand while holding Omar's other hand away from the screen.
Lucia, want me to bring beans when I pass by? The north wind has that heavy smell again.
If you're already coming, yes. I shut Omar's room window.
I'll text from the driveway. The big pickups are rushing past after the breakfast shift.
Lucia, tengo sopa lista. Vi la camioneta de Mateo pasar con pacas y pense que llegan cansados hoy.
Gracias, Rosa. Omar durmio despues de oir el motor afuera y el silbido de Mateo.
Ese nino va a conocer los patios, las maquinas y los vecinos que trabajan la tierra antes de caminar.
Mateo dice que mejor conozca tambien los aparatos que ahorran agua. Asi ayuda sin tanto cansancio.
Lucia, I made caldo. I can leave a container by the door when Omar wakes.
Thank you, Rosa. We are staying in tonight and using what we have.
Need anything from Dollar General? I saw baby spoons and wipes on clearance.
Maybe wipes only. The spoons can wait since Elena found some in her kitchen box.
Mi amor, after the song he did not sleep right away. He watched my hands clap soft.
He has been doing that more this week.
Then he tried to grab the spoon when I was mixing masa. Strong little fingers.
I put aside the old songbook and the big crayons for when he is bigger, junto con la pelota chiquita.
Mija, si vienen despues de la siesta, tu tio ya tiene listo el canal de los Cowboys.
Vamos cuando coma Omar. Traigo su cobijita azul para que no se asuste con los gritos.
Yo le canto quedito cuando empiecen. Tambien hice arroz para todos.
Left the black CD by the chair. Track 4 is the soft one he liked last night.
I saw it. He blinked slow when your voice came on the little video too.
If he gets tight before nap, open the window a crack if it's not dusty. The cattle are close today.
Leaving the yard late today. If your mom calls Ceci, tell them I can jump on after bath.
Okay. I will keep him wrapped and play it low.
Lucia said they want to see him kick in the tub, so maybe 7:40.
Ok. Funny how my dad still says we should have gone south when Omar was born.
Lucia says Hereford is hard some weeks, but the clinic, your work, and Elena are here.
I'm almost home. Is he still crying?
Yes. The cousins were laughing loud on the phone and he hadn't eaten enough before the bath.
I'll take him in the room and hum. Put the little blanket ready?
It's on the chair. Talk soft when you come in, he keeps jumping when voices change fast.
I'm passing United on 25 Mile. Need anything for the baby?
If you can grab diapers, I'll send you 28 when Mateo's hours clear. We used the last bigger pack.
No me mandes nada. I'll get diapers and tortillas. Do you still need a ride Tuesday?
Yes please, if Mateo can't leave the yard. We are keeping gas for work and clinic only.
I found a 6-9 month denim romper and two plain onesies. Want them before I give the rest away?
Yes please. Anything soft and easy to change helps.
I'll bring them with the little colors book. It has red/rojo and blue/azul on each page.
Perfect. We can keep that one by the crib with the blanket from San Antonio.
Mija, I made extra tacos de papa. Want me to leave a plate by the door?
Yes please, gracias. Omar is finally asleep so just knock soft.
Claro. I put two without salsa in case you want to sit with him when he wakes.
Lucia, I made extra rice and caldo. Want me to leave some by the door before evening prayers?
Yes please, Omar finally fell asleep. Mateo can grab it after he lights the little candle for his grandpa.
Claro. Also my niece said the county form has a blank write-in line now, easier than those old boxes.
Good. I always end up writing the same thing we say at home anyway.
Lucia, I made extra caldo. Want me to leave a container by your door?
Yes please, if it is no trouble. We used the grocery cash for diapers after Omar went through so many.
No trouble. I can hold him ten minutes too if you need to finish the phone payment online.
Mija, Rosa asked if Mateo still wanted that paper from church. I told her I would ask you first.
Yes, but just send a photo to Mateo. We don't need it passed around.
Claro. After dinner we can talk with your suegro if Omar is calm.
That works. I want to hear what he thinks before we decide anything.
Lucia, voy al Allsup's. ¿Te traigo agua o wipes? Vi mucha patrulla por 385 hoy.
Wipes por favor. Mateo dijo que mejor revisa la luz de atrás antes de salir.
Buena idea. Trae tus papeles cerquita y no te apures. ¿El niño sigue con siesta?
Sí, dormido con el puñito cerrado. Si despierta, solo quiere biberón.
Lucia, I made extra caldo. Want me to leave some by the door? I heard the meeting got loud about the officers at the school game.
Si, gracias. Mateo said better not take Omar over there. We talked with my aunt after, just us.
Good. People here remember who helped with diapers and who looked away when checks were short.
That's why we listen for who keeps the clinic open and doesn't talk down to families like ours.
Prima, I can take you Thursday morning. My comadre from the school line said the baby scale is fixed now.
Gracias. I want to ask about Omar pushing away the bottle, but only if the same lady is there.
I will go inside with you. Bring the papers in one folder and we leave if they start calling too many people to the counter.
Okay. After that we can stop for diapers if the card works.
Buenos dias, hija. Did Omar sleep after you gave him la toma at dawn?
A little. He ate from me at 5:20 and again just now, so I'll wait before the little green spoon.
Muy bien. Keep the paper for the office, they always ask exact times.
I have it in the blue folder with the card receipt from yesterday.
Como esta mi niño? Did he rest after the clinic paper day?
He slept on my chest. Dr. Salazar said the next one is in April, so I put it on the fridge.

events.title: March envelopes after Mateo's Friday check

events.title: Omar check-in and measurements
events.notes: Bring diaper bag, blue blanket, feeding notes, and questions about longer awake stretches. Ask if the vitamin drops timing can stay after morning bottle.

events.title: Sort Omar papers for clinic folder

events.title: Omar 6-month check, bring blue card

events.title: Call Little Steps on Main

events.title: Drop Mateo by north pens before WIC

events.title: WIC pickup, electric bill, check green envelope

events.title: Diapers, pan dulce, church parking lot swap

events.title: Omar checkup

events.title: Elena coming by - masa, hojas, quiet room ready

events.title: At Elena's - Cowboys on after feeding
events.notes: Pack burp cloths, extra onesie, and small blanket. Keep Omar near the couch once the family turns on the Hereford High School game.

events.title: Living room mat before family meal
events.notes: Set out yellow cloth square, two small blocks, and silver rattle. Keep TV low while cousins arrive. Pause if chairs scrape or anyone starts clapping.

events.title: Mateo home: porch hold before bath
events.notes: Blanket by the door. Keep it short if the wind kicks up; low radio after bath if he stays awake.

events.title: Pick two Omar pictures for family thread
events.notes: Use blanket photo and bath towel grin. Crop fridge papers. Mateo to send one to his mom from his phone.

events.title: WhatsApp: Ceci / Abuela

events.title: Quiet room after family dinner
events.notes: Ask Elena to start with the old verse she used last visit; keep phone volume low if using saved clip.

events.title: Blessing after service + family lunch

events.notes: Bring Omar's blanket, small candle, envelope from Abuela's town, and the packet with his long name spelled both ways.

events.title: Before family dinner: nap, dim room, one person holds Omar
events.notes: Keep music low until after he eats. No passing him around before 4:30. Blanket in crib drawer.

events.title: Blanket time by west window
events.notes: Set out soft rattle, cloth book, small foam ball, fat crayon box for later. Try Mateo humming one quiet song before bath if Omar keeps tracking everything.

events.title: Sunday visit at Elena's
events.notes: Pack extra snap shirt from aunt's bag, soft blanket, board book with English words, and ask Elena to sing the old lullaby after dinner.

events.title: Before clinic ride: folder, car seat, copies
events.notes: Put gray folder in diaper bag side pocket; check car seat straps; bring blue blanket and extra bottle. No courthouse errands on this trip.

events.title: Kitchen table call with Tia and Elena
events.notes: Keep Omar asleep. Ask about school board packet, clinic paperwork, and Mateo's overtime check. No posting in big chat about the downtown march photos.

events.title: Call Tia after Omar's bedtime
events.notes: Ask what her side heard about the county item. Keep TV low; no group chat replies until morning.

events.title: Voucher reload + Omar question
events.notes: Elena can wait in lobby with stroller. Ask front desk if Ana from Sunday service is working. Keep IDs and address mail together.

events.title: Omar 4-month visit

events.notes: Bring shot card, blue folder, extra sleeper, and bottle. Ask nurse to copy the page with hospital stamp for daycare packet.

events.title: Phone check: baby card reload
events.notes: Have March feeding log ready. Ask whether the mashed green fruit counts as a taste only. Confirm next month's card amount before grocery trip.

events.title: WIC follow-up, bring Omar folder
events.notes: Show blue card and ask Maria which public page she mentioned. Add April clinic date to phone after.

events.title: Amarillo appointment and big-store list

events.title: WIC folder and address form
events.notes: Pack two diapers, wipes, bottle, and the same address note used on newborn paperwork.

events.title: WIC weight check and formula questions

events.title: Pediatric check-in and WIC folder

events.title: WIC recert packet

events.notes: Pack formula card, blanket, and extra onesie. Review March sheet before leaving: weeks 0; hours 0; places 0; amount $0.

events.title: Library baby hour if nap works
events.notes: Only go if he wakes calm. Take cloth book, wipes, and no-spend bag. Ask about free board books and Spanish song sheet.

events.title: Quiet night routine
events.notes: Bath towel, clean diaper, 6 oz bottle, Spanish song, crib by 7:45. Keep porch visits short after Mateo parks.

events.title: Omar - feeding check
events.notes: Bring blue folder, bottle log, and the printed screenshots. Ask staff to go over the ounces page with Elena before leaving.

events.title: Drop papers at Workforce office
events.notes: Bring diploma copy, old diner reference, Mrs. Valdez phone number. Only go if Elena can sit with Omar after his 9:15 bottle. Ask about morning openings that cover more than $175/wk.

events.title: Sort kitchen drawer papers after Omar bedtime
events.notes: Keep car insurance card, IDs, clinic copies, and county mail together. Shred old flyers. No fines or court dates listed on fridge.

events.title: Dinner at home - Rangers 7:05
events.notes: Move play mat away from TV stand. Keep volume under 18 after bottle; switch to Lucia's Spanish playlist if Omar gets fussy.

events.title: Quiet floor setup before Rosa stops by
events.notes: Use quilt on carpet, striped crinkle cloth, three blocks, and small rattle. Let him watch from lap first if visitors come in talking. Practice slow roll to left after bottle.

events.title: Family errand: gloves, bottle nipples, water-meter pamphlet
events.notes: Ask about small solar timer display Mateo mentioned; keep receipt for work gloves.

events.title: Family stop after feed store
events.location: Hereford feed store and park by the small goals
events.notes: Pick up diapers, then let Omar sit with shade blanket if he is still looking around. Aunt bringing tiny boots photo from the county barn table; Mateo wants a picture near the painted lines before lunch.

events.title: Night routine - bedroom
events.notes: Dim lamp, no TV. Play Elena clip first, then Lucia sings the short verse if he is still squirming.

events.title: Sort dresser after laundry
events.notes: Move out tight sleepers, keep aunt's plain onesies in top drawer, set aside clean Rangers shirt, put abuela song playlist and English animal cards in night basket.

events.title: Sunday visit with Elena
events.notes: Take Omar's sweater, the rosary pouch, copies of the clinic/WIC pages, and the family recipe notebook with Abuela's Michoacan address tucked inside.

events.title: Sunday call after Omar's nap
events.notes: Upload two new photos before ringing. Ask about July weekend and whether the Monterrey house has room for the travel crib.
